notes.title: Soundtracks will be a paid item
notes.content:
It appears that I was mistaken and the soundtrack was released for free.

A short time later,
- Purchasers of "Fly Me To The Home!" will continue to be able to download the soundtrack for free.
- Only the soundtrack cannot be downloaded for free.
- Soundtracks can only be purchased.

Please understand the above.

notes.title: Bug fixes (BGM, LEVEL 50)
notes.content:
I announced that the BGM bug and LEVEL 50 specs were fixed, but they were still buggy.
I believe it has finally been fixed.

I'm very sorry for any inconvenience caused.

Please let me know if there are still bugs.


*The difficulty level of some LEVELs has been reduced.

notes.title: Change BGM mechanism
notes.content:
I have changed the underlying mechanism to fix a bug that prevented BGM looping from working in some environments.
However, this may cause other BGM bugs. Our apologies.

notes.title: Fixed difficulty mechanism for LEVEL 50
notes.content:
A bug has been fixed where the difficulty level at LEVEL 50 varied depending on the environment.
It increases the difficulty for many players. Our apologies.

ツ

notes.title: Released!
notes.content:
Finally released!
One week only sale, 20% off!

ツ

notes.title: BGM loop bug fixed
notes.content: The loop specification was a bit strange in the background music, but it has been fixed (ツ

notes.title: UI is a little better!
notes.content:
Some of the UI has been updated a bit clearer and with animations, which is a nice touch!
In addition, the names of those who have completed an additional survey have been added to the credit display screen!

 (ツ)

notes.title: Fixed the rounding error of the third decimal place in the time display
notes.content:
The third decimal place (1/1000th of a second) in the time display was sometimes +- 1 because of the rounding error.
After this update, times will no longer be shifted.

*Times that have already been uploaded/recorded will be left as they are, as it is difficult to correct them due to the specifications.

notes.title: Demo Updated
notes.content:
In preparation for the release of the full version, the specifications of the trial version have been changed.

The changes are as follows

[olist]
[*]The number of playable levels has been reduced from 25 to 12
[*]Skin implementation
[*]Some effects and animations have been added
[*]Improved UI experience, especially the menus
[*]Leaderboards and achievements added
[*]Various bug fixes
[/olist]

Thank you in advance!
